scope: Offline, non-admitting candidate integration; no actual source activation.

assertions.neutralSourceContract: Exact declared issuer CIK/name/relationship, dedicated kind/family, strict SEC endpoint and host. Candidate shape plans but performs zero requests.
assertions.neutralCollection: Bounded 365-day default traversal, required older indexes, preserved document URL associations, zero structured/extraction/review calls, zero facts, no prior semantic hashes carried into the head.
assertions.independentReconcile: Replays exact archived source/url/body documents against helper; requires exact summary, manifest, observation order, original final URLs and timestamp bounds. Rejects forged summaries, facts, semantic work, missing bodies and accession omissions.
assertions.clock: Immutable UTC traversal-as-of; verification follows the last source observation; a UTC-day crossing holds the check. Advancing-clock fixture accepts a filing that arrives during request without renewing observation dates.
assertions.transport: Same-run strict data.sec.gov HTTP200 bytes share across target suppliers; each retains distinct source observations and validation. Conditional304, failed and broader/ordinary policies stay separate. Parent structured facts remain attached only to the parent subject.
assertions.foreignForms: 20-F,20-F/A,6-K,6-K/A primary documents retained with exact URL/date bindings and zero fact/model admission.
assertions.existingCertifiedPath: The actual 16-company contract and certified SEC cache path are unchanged.
assertions.neutralEmptyFields: All five semantic/fact fields require exact empty arrays (default absent=[]); falsy nonarrays fail in reconciliation and partial paths. Neutral accession manifests require actual arrays of unique safe accession strings.

actualHistoricalIssuerReplay.limitation: Prepared separately by the helper owner. Exact historical issuer-index checks only; no declared segment relationship is qualified, no complete actual source activation/collection is claimed.

remaining: Root review and ordinary candidate CI; real source and issuer/segment relationship qualification plus normal collection/gate remain separate. No existing gap is waived.
